## AC EVIDENCE — post-fix main run 33577216351 (merged SHA 024a6a227813, includes 2479 + 2501)

Non-vacuous: 13 positive anchors, not an empty/skipped log.

AC-1 (anchor asserted FIRST):
    $ gh run view 33577216351 --log | grep -cF 'Successfully installed uv 0.12.7'
    13
    (e.g. "Successfully installed uv 0.12.7 from uv-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"; ".../uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz")

AC-1 (zero manifest fetch):
    $ gh run view 33577216351 --log | grep -cF 'Fetching manifest data'
    0

AC-2: installed uv version in the same log == 0.12.7 == `[tool.uv] required-version` pin in pyproject.toml.

AC-3: residual network dependency named honestly = the uv binary download from the Astral GitHub release URL (`from uv-<target>.tar.gz`), exactly as Approach B (composite action, committed sha256) documented. The manifest (raw.githubusercontent.com) fetch is eliminated; the release-CDN binary download is not, and is not claimed to be.

All three ACs met. Closing 5caa; caused_by 56b7-b21a-c8ab-4afc (incomplete-implementation).
